next.reason: §2023:8.3.5 SR8 keeps exceptions a) to c) ('closing delimiter of a literal' covers the 1985 closing quotation mark). Its added d) ('The terminating period of a data description entry that ends with a PICTURE clause that contains a comma or period as the last character') refuses nothing new: §1985:VI.5.9.5 already says of a final insertion comma or period that the PICTURE clause 'must be immediately followed by the separator period', so 'PIC 999, .' was refused in 1985 too (the recheck did not see that text). Same programs accepted and refused.
